facts.fact: La Presse states that circular n°5 of 2 September 2026 requires public bodies to report problems immediately to the national cybersecurity agency (Agence nationale de la sécurité cybernétique), whose technical recommendations the circular follows, and that it rests on the 2023 cybersecurity decree.
